primary_metric: presence_auc_V: ROC AUC on VALIDATE of the rule's point-in-time score (no own-state) for 'wallet has >=1 BUY fill in (market, 6h bin)', universe U = Gamma markets endDate in window, volumeNum>=20k, resolved before H, non-sports, non-Up/Down; cells endDate-14d .. min(closedTime, endDate+14d)

split.BUILD: endDate in [2026-06-01, 2026-09-01), closedTime < H (fit on all wallet-traded BUILD-universe markets + fixed random 2,000 others, weighted)
split.VALIDATE: endDate in [2026-09-01, 2026-10-23), closedTime < H (full universe: 3,419 markets, 117,132 cells, 277 positive cells, 57 positive markets)
split.holdout: endDate/resolution on or after 2026-10-23 (never loaded; October 2026 FOMC excluded)

data_sources: gamma /markets universe scans by endDate (vol>=20k): VALIDATE 47,211 raw / 3,419 kept; BUILD 84,184 raw / 7,315 kept
clob /prices-history hourly for universe markets (VALIDATE all; BUILD wallet-traded + 2,000 sample)
Polygon receipts (drpc) of the wallet's trade transactions -> OrderFilled with orderHash (VALIDATE period; BUILD Jul15-Aug31 queued)
